Compiler flags: tsconfig.app.json sets `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters`, `erasableSyntaxOnly` and `verbatimModuleSyntax`. The only global stylesheet, src/index.css, zeroes margin and sets height 100%. The starter&#39;s styles.css is comment-only and says the kit supplies no colors, fonts, borders, shadows or spacing. In the kit components, inline styles are structural only: position, inset, flex, overflow, transform scale, a list-style reset, and fixed TOC and stage offsets. Arrow uses currentColor for stroke and fill, so it sets no color of its own. Stage and Appear animate opacity only for transitions. A grep of the bootstrap src for hex/rgb/hsl colors, font-family, box-shadow, border, background, color and CSS custom properties found nothing outside comments. The registry only lazy-loads the Talk. Talk.tsx only composes Presentation with STEPS and the title. steps/index.ts builds Step records. scene.tsx maps presentation-local entities to kit nodes. The kit holds the shared mechanisms. The required title input is consumed: Talk passes title to Presentation, which forwards it as deckTitle to Header, which renders it in the h1. Every shared constant I traced has a consumer in the packet. DESIGN_W and DESIGN_H are used in Stage and Arrow. MIN_SCALE, NARROW_MAX_WIDTH, NARROW_SIDE and STAGE_LAYOUT are used in fitScale and Stage. TOC_MIN_WIDTH and TOC_WIDTH are used in Presentation, Stage and fitScale. SWIPE_MIN_DISTANCE is used in navKeys. The ENTER/EXIT/LAYOUT timing constants and EASE are used in Stage, Appear, Arrow and props. The DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTION constants are used in Footer. The review guidance counts a sample as missing when its steps content is absent, and says a failure that surfaces only as a later render timeout does not name the failed phase. Before rendering, main() in scripts/verify.mjs runs only two sample checks (lines 91-95). One checks that the slug appears in src/presentations/index.ts, and registeredSlugs() finds it with a regex over the file text (preview.mjs lines 15-18). The other checks that the registry is not empty. Neither looks at the sample&#39;s steps, titles or captions. Every comparison of steps content runs inside renderPresentation, after the browser has loaded the page and found the chrome. The step-count comparison is at line 57, after the waitForSelector at line 49. The per-step era/title/caption check, expectSampleStep (lines 22-34), is called from the step loop at line 66. Both compare the expected outline in verify.config.json against the rendered DOM. Neither reads the source steps. Now suppose the sample is still registered but its steps array is empty. Presentation.tsx line 15 returns null when there is no step, so no [data-step-count] element renders.
